A sticky substance used to craft {c_important}Charms{/c} and {c_important}Seals{/c} in the {icon:APS_Reward_CubeMaterials, 1.5} {c_important}Horadric Cube{/c}

Obtained from salvaging Talisman Charms and Seals.
Considered foundational to the study of alchemy, herbs serve to bond and enhance other elixirs.
